note: Kimi K3.1 Pro NVFP4 + DSpark under vLLM, TP8 attention x DP2 / EP16 MoE over two 8-GPU nodes. rules.json is generated by make_rules.py from this topology's timing-predict cost manifest; the GB200 TP16 and B200 TP8xDP2 packs share the compute rules and differ in the boundary collectives the manifest declares. Checked on the phase-1 diverse_100 capture: the rule set reaches a fixpoint in 3 sweeps with no disagreements and no label-check findings, 97.0% of measured kernel time mapped (forward 98.6%). Every rule names its owner from the vLLM call site (vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/*.py) and the kernel's neighbours; nothing is labeled to raise coverage. Only the EP16 dispatch all-gather / combine reduce-scatter are synchronizing here: the attention TP group is one DP group (8 of 16 ranks), and the analyzer models a barrier over every rank of an iteration, so the DP-group collectives (ShardQ, sequence-parallel all-gather / reduce-scatter, embedding and draft all-reduces, logits all-gathers) are classed independent; their within-group wait is then counted as the waiting rank's busy time.

source.check: label evaluation of the capture's kernel sequences (3-sweep fixpoint, no disagreements). The analyzer's Check 1 on this capture is blocked: its DP ranks logged no dummy forwards, so the two DP groups' iterations do not pair (see the PR's known gaps).

unmapped_decisions.note: Rules write only mapped labels, plus unmapped synchronizing collectives where a collective spans every rank, so an unmapped decision is the initialized label left in place. Each measured kernel family that stays unmapped is listed with its reason; no simulated slot owns it.

forward.elementwise_kernel between the q_absorb: q_nope/q_pe concat into the FP8 query buffer; torch glue the simulator does not price as its own leaf
forward.unrolled direct_copy / vectorized_gather: ShardQ row selection (index_q_input[rows], index_weights[rows]) and the indexer's per-chunk gathers; torch glue with no slot
forward.vectorized_elementwise between cp_gather: indexer logits workspace fill and casts
forward.vectorized_elementwise after _pad_query_: fill of the padded query heads
forward.kernels at a folded-segment edge whose o: owner not decidable from in-body neighbours; left unmapped rather than guessed

draft.elementwise_kernel / CatArrayBatchedCopy: DSpark input assembly (context hidden concat, position/slot gathers) and the draft-context K norm/rope casts; the simulated draft stage has no leaf for them
draft.ncclDevKernel_AllGather (draft logits): left at its initialized label (no rule): the draft head has no logits all-gather slot, and it waits only on its DP group, so it is not a barrier here

preprocess.all preprocess kernels (_stage_spec_deco: input preparation and attention metadata; per-iteration overhead with no CostTree leaf

sample.ncclDevKernel_AllGather (target logits): left at its initialized label (no rule): no logits all-gather slot, and it waits only on its DP group, so it is not a barrier here

bookkeep._prepare_commit_plan, _compact_conv_stat: RecoverSSM state commit and scheduler bookkeeping after verification; not modelled (about 0.5% of measured kernel time)
